name: PT Citra Nusantara Gemilang Tbk
summary: PT Citra Nusantara Gemilang Tbk, an energy company, engages in the trading and distribution of natural gas in the form of compressed natural gas (CNG) to the industrial, retail, and transportation sectors in Indonesia. The company is also involved in the trading, sale, and installation of gas equipment; engineering, procurement, and construction of CNG stations; vehicle conversion and maintenance; construction, operation, and maintenance of independent power plants; and operation and maintenance of CNG plants. It offers its products under the GASRA brand. PT Citra Nusantara Gemilang Tbk was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Bekasi, Indonesia.
